audit.why: 54.47% over 929 games with diff FAVOURED 4/10 lines up, and both layers already agree the chart is Akshan every row.
audit.corrected: Favoured lane throughout; the only stage that narrows is 2+ items when she fights with a team around Command: Shockwave.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and whys[5] sit on the wrong stages (rows 4 and 5 are Level 6 and First item), and whys[6] merges two stages into one row.
audit.why: Command: Shockwave arrives at 6 on a 110-second cooldown with only 410 units of reach around the ball; the first-item stage is where swing-autos start cutting through the armour and magic resist Command: Protect lends.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = a 410-range Shockwave she has to walk into position; First item = swing-autos out-damage her shield-and-resist package; 2+ items = grouped Shockwave is her only flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heroic Swing is called a dash in five places, and the decisive Comeuppance interaction is never stated.
audit.why: Akshan has no dash — Heroic Swing needs terrain and knocks him off on champion or wall collision. More importantly, Comeuppance damages the first champion, MINION or structure hit, so a wave standing between you and Orianna eats the whole ultimate. Command: Protect (E, 9s) also grants bonus Armor and Magic Resist alongside the shield, so she can pre-emptively blunt a stored Comeuppance on herself or an ally.
audit.corrected: Fire Comeuppance down a clean line — the first minion in the path absorbs it. Her Command: Protect is a flat 9-second cooldown that both shields and adds resistances, so bait it before the release rather than after. Command: Attack (Q) costs only 35 mana, so she can poke through your mana bar; the punish window is its 7/6/5/4/3-second cooldown, not her mana.

audit.why: Command: Shockwave is 110s at rank 1, Command: Attack drops to 3s at rank 5, and Command: Dissonance is a flat 7s.
audit.corrected: Step up on the Command: Attack cooldown early; commit fully in the 110 seconds after she spends Shockwave.

notes: No fabricated ability names in this matchup and the level chart already agreed across both layers, so no chart edits were needed. The recurring defect was calling Heroic Swing a dash (whys[2], whys[3], early, mid, late, wants.you[1]); Akshan has no dash and the swing needs terrain. Added the Comeuppance minion-block interaction, which was absent everywhere: the ultimate hits the first champion, minion or structure in its path.
